posts.title: Clickbait is kak, so I built Just Tell Me, Bru!
posts.description: I asked my friend “What’s more painful? Clickbait headlines or passing kidney stones?” He replied “Let’s put it this way, a clickbait headline has never made me cry myself to sleep at night.” That’s not really the answer I wanted going into this article. I haven’t had kidney stones, but every time I see a clickbait article it’s at least the mental equivalent of stubbing my toe on a coffee table.

posts.title: Using a shock collar to stop myself doomscrolling
posts.description: I’m hooked up to the dopamine scroll machine where Meta harvests my soul for advertising. At this point that’s how I see it.
